3 mistakes that make animated videos look cheap, and how to fix each one.

1. Too many ideas. One video should carry one message. If you explain five things, viewers remember none.
2. Text nobody can read. Use large, high contrast text and keep each line to a few words so it reads on a phone in one second.
3. No next step. End every video with one clear action so viewers know what to do after watching.

Professional animation is mostly good decisions: a simple script, clean motion and a clear ending. Pixevon Productions makes animated videos, motion graphics and short documentaries for brands. Contact us to learn more.

How do you explain a product in 30 seconds? Use the problem, solution, result structure.

1. Problem: show the pain your customer feels in the first seconds so they recognize themselves.
2. Solution: show your product fixing it with simple, clear motion, not a feature list.
3. Result: finish with the outcome, such as time saved or money earned, and one next step.

Animated explainer videos keep people watching longer than long product pages because they show the idea instead of describing it. Pixevon Productions turns your offer into a clear animated explainer for your website and social media. Contact us to learn more.

Short video hook tips: you have 3 seconds to win a viewer. Rule 1: open with a bold first line. Rule 2: add movement from frame one. Rule 3: give a reason to keep watching. Apply these to every reel and your retention improves. Contact us to learn more.

#ShortFormVideo #VideoHooks #ReelsTips #SocialMediaMarketing #MotionGraphics
posts.caption_long:
Short video hook tips: you have 3 seconds to win a viewer.

Rule 1: Open with a bold first line that names a problem or a surprising result.
Rule 2: Add movement from frame one, because a still frame gets scrolled past.
Rule 3: Give a reason to stay, such as a promise, a question or a list that is about to be revealed.

Watch your retention after 3 seconds and rewrite the first line until it holds. Pixevon Productions makes animated short videos built around strong hooks. Contact us to learn more.

posts.caption:
What does an animated logo do for your brand? It makes every video instantly recognizable.

Logo animation tips:
1. Keep it short. 3 to 5 seconds is enough for an intro.
2. Use your brand colors and one clean motion, not five effects.
3. Use the same animation at the start or end of every video so viewers connect your content to your brand.
4. Export a version with a transparent background so you can use it anywhere.

People remember what moves. Pixevon Productions animates logos and builds motion graphics for businesses. Contact us to learn more.

3. Show the product or result in motion.

posts.caption_long:
Most people watch social media video on mute, so a video that needs sound loses viewers.

How to make video that works without sound:
1. Add captions that match the voice.
2. Use large text for the key idea of each scene.
3. Show the idea with motion, not only words.
4. Add voice and soft music for people who do listen.

Test your video on mute before you post it. Pixevon Productions designs animated videos that work with or without sound. Contact us to learn more.
